thread:
maya: deploy-bot blocked RC4 - cosign signature missing on artifacts but SBOM and vuln-scan passed. tagging to triage.
deploy-bot: automated alert: release-candidate rc4 blocked -> missing signature: cosign verification failed for image redwood/inference:rc4 (signature: none). see /artifacts/rc4.
oliver: what does vuln-scan show? any criticals?
maya: vuln scan green (low/med only), SBOM present. problem is cosign key rotation during packaging window — signatures didn’t attach.
priya: ok. can we do a conditional canary (EU only) while we re-run signing? we need release momentum for regional customer. propose: 2h EU canary, 5% traffic, auto rollback on error rate >1% or latency 2x.
alex: implementable. command to trigger: ```/deploy --image redwood/inference:rc4 --canary region=eu traffic=5% duration=2h rollback_on=error>1%``` deploy-bot will enforce rollback thresholds.
oliver: security asks for: (1) evidence of key rotation timeline and who triggered it, (2) temporary exception logged in approval queue, (3) stricter monitoring hooks for canary.
maya: I can attach cosign run logs and KMS audit trace once signing completes. filing exception in release approvals now.
legal-bot: quick check — does this artifact contain customer PII or regulated tensors?
maya: no customer data embedded. artifacts are model weights + code. legal-bot: ok noted. file an ops ticket if anything changes.
priya: can we make the canary timeboxed so it auto-unpublishes after 2h even if no rollback? prefer that.
alex: yes; deploy-bot supports timebox. also adding perf and error probes to /observability/canaries/rc4-eu.
oliver: approve conditional carveout if: (A) we attach cosign re-run logs within 3 hours, (B) deploy-bot enforces rollback thresholds, (C) we update release notes with signature delay note and evidence link.
maya: agreed. I'll run signing job now, ping when done. scheduling EU canary start in 15m.
priya: +1 :thumbsup: will update release notes: "RC4: short EU canary due to delayed artifact signature; monitoring in place; full rollout paused pending signature evidence."
deploy-bot: canary scheduled: rc4-eu-canary starting in 15m. will enforce rollback criteria and auto-unpublish at 2h.
maya: thanks all — will post cosign logs and KMS audit here when available.
alex: I'll keep an eye on observability and have rollback runbook ready.
oliver: keeping security channel on watch, will review logs when posted.
maya: (after) cosign re-run completed, logs attached: https://artifacts.redwood/signatures/rc4/cosign-log.txt. KMS audit: https://audit.redwood/kms/rotate/2024-03-11.
priya: evidence attached, starting EU canary now.
deploy-bot: canary started. monitoring links: https://obs.redwood/canaries/rc4-eu.
priya: if we see >1% errors or service latency spike, we roll back immediately. Alex, ready?
alex: ready. rollback command in runbook: ```/rollback redwood/inference:rc3 --region eu --reason "canary-error-threshold"```
maya: closing thread — will update release notes and approval ticket after full signature verification. :white_check_mark:
